requirement:
Evidence inputs MAY have a definition form containing exactly `definition` and `text`. `definition` MUST identify one named definition; `text` MUST contain its complete raw fenced declaration as source lines, including its phrase option and explanatory body.

Validation MUST reject missing definitions and changed snapshot text, identifying the definition and showing a compact diff when available. Moving an unchanged definition within its chapter MUST NOT invalidate its snapshot. Evidence displays MUST show the definition name, current source location, and recorded text.
rationale:
Each obligation of `requirements.definitions.inputs` maps to a marked test with real assertions.

- **Exact form (`definition` and `text` only).** `tests/definitions.rs#fn[definition_schema_deletion_and_literal_references_are_checked]` adds an `unexpected` field to a definition input. It asserts an "unexpected field" error.
- **`definition` must identify one named definition.**
  - `src/evidence.rs#mod[tests]/fn[configuration_and_dependency_failures_do_not_stop_later_checks]` uses a nonexistent `rules.gone`. It asserts the "no matching named definition" error for that input.
  - `definition_schema_deletion_and_literal_references_are_checked` deletes `md/glossary.md`. It asserts that `glossary.a` is reported as "no matching named definition".
  - `tests/definitions.rs#fn[changed_definition_snapshots_show_a_compact_diff_and_text_is_required]` names a requirement (`rules.ready`) and an example (`rules.case`) as the definition. It asserts the same error for each, so only definitions are accepted.
- **`text` is the complete raw fenced declaration as source lines.**
  - The helpers `declaration` and `definition` build `text` from the full opening fence through the closing fence, including the phrase option and body. Validation accepts that form in every passing scenario.
  - `changed_definition_snapshots_show_a_compact_diff_and_text_is_required` removes `text`, sets it to an empty array, and sets it to a non-array string. Each case must produce an error that mentions `text`.
  - `tests/definitions.rs#fn[cyclic_dependencies_are_required_once_and_changes_require_review]` changes the phrase option and the body text. Each change is rejected as "input text changed" and names the right definition, so both the option and the body are part of the snapshot.
- **Reject missing definitions and changed snapshot text, identifying the definition and showing a compact diff.** The deletion, phrase-change, and body-change tests above cover rejection and name the definition. `changed_definition_snapshots_show_a_compact_diff_and_text_is_required` asserts the exact diff lines after the header: one removal line and one addition line, with no unchanged lines.
- **Moving an unchanged definition within its chapter does not invalidate the snapshot.** `cyclic_dependencies_are_required_once_and_changes_require_review` prepends blank lines to `md/glossary.md`, which shifts both definitions. It asserts there are no validation errors.
- **Displays show the definition name, current source location, and recorded text.** `src/index.rs#mod[tests]/fn[detail_page_shows_recorded_text_locations_and_first_matching_group]` asserts the definition heading, the file and range location entry, and the recorded text block. It also asserts their order and their placement under "Referenced definitions".

I looked for tests that feed validation a snapshot whose fence lines differ or are missing. I found none. The requirement's wording on a changed snapshot is general, and the option and body changes are covered, so I do not count this as an established gap.
